answer:
The OpenAI-compatible endpoint that lets apps stream speech audio generated by Ollama on macOS is `/v1/audio/speech`. This endpoint is mentioned in the context:

- "Ollama can now generate [speech](https://docs.ollama.com/capabilities/speech) on macOS. `ollama run` plays text or a chat model's reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint." [ollama/v0.40.11.md (lines 1-12)]

- "Generates audio with [speech models](/capabilities/speech). The response streams while audio is generated." [ollama/docs/api/openai-compatibility.md (lines 318-335)] 

"Note: Added in Ollama v0.40.8" [ollama/docs/api/openai-compatibility.md (lines 318-335)] indicates that this capability was introduced in version 0.40.8.
